data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account leading to increased claims reserves.
Further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account increasing ultimate claims reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate strengthened prior years' claims reserves by GBP 23.342m (an ~8.4% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 278.997m) during 2014. The increases relate primarily to adverse development in the Liability (US) account and movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account, with increases of GBP 16.719m and GBP 6.623m respectively, affecting 2012 and prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased.
These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.
The result was affected by worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account and further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account.
the majority of the loss for the year emanates from the liability line of business on the 2013 and prior years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) prior year column. Prior year reserve movement taken from Note 5 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which lists gross increases by internal class (Treaty and Liability). No gross claims development triangle was present in the provided pages; calculations are based on explicit note figures (thousands converted to millions). Percentages for LOB movement are computed from loss ratio changes shown in the note (Dec 2014 vs Dec 2013).
